0.original: Uin Nee cannot wait another moment to have their bidding done.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Keep watch at Good Jenanna's Grace, and slay a witchweed for its petals.

25.original: Deliver the witchweed petals to Uin Nee.

48.original: Oh, no! I've gone and done it again─forgotten something deathly important! Forgotten what, you say? Silly mortal─that's what I'm trying to remember!

49.original: Oh, but of course─witchweed petals! Somehow I've managed to completely exhaust my supply! This simply won't do. No, not at all!

50.original: Fortunately, you've turned up just at the right time to help me set things right! It's really most impressive how you always seem to know when I need you. Now, off with you to Good Jenanna's Grace, where the most frilly and flowery of witchweeds roam! Don't worry, I'll look after things here.

51.original: Oh, look who's back! Did you bring the─wait, what was it that I asked you for again?

52.original: But of course! Witchweed petals! How could I forget? Speaking of forgetting, I completely forgot to tell you why I needed them in the first place didn't I?

53.original: If you were paying attention─and you always pay attention, don't you─I'm sure you noticed how witchweeds change their petals to resemble the shape of their prey. The poor little creatures approach, thinking they've found a friend, and─GULP! GNASH! No more little creature.

54.original: <sniff> Poor little things... Anyhow, where was I? Oh yes! If I have witchweed petals, all I need to do is weave a simple spell and I can spin all sorts of cute animals for my little dreamers!

55.original: But whatever sort of creature shall I conjure up first? Perhaps a little ladybug? A wriggly worm? Perhaps an army of itsy-bitsy spiders! Wait─how about <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103> of them! Yes, I'll simply bury them in bugs! Don't you wish you were a child still so you could dream such lovely dreams?
